Method of Attack: Exfiltrates sensitive data to oastify.com endpoint using obfuscated JavaScript code.
Typosquatting to mimic the legitimate library monolith and exfiltrate metadata via multiple OAST endpoints.
DNS-based reconnaissance to exfiltrate system information via DNS queries to an attacker-controlled oastify.com endpoint.
Attack Vector: Malicious JavaScript code in npm package.
Typosquatting and malicious Python script in PyPI package.
